zh-CN.title: 优化启动更新检查体验

sections.title: 检查更新
items: 启动后等待网络就绪再自动检查，并在临时网络故障时静默重试一次，减少首次启动误报
手动检查始终优先，不再因后台自动重试延长等待时间
更新请求超时时显示明确提示，不再暴露底层 AbortSignal 错误

zh-CN.notice: 更新后请完整重启 Tabby。现有命令库和插件设置会保留。

en.title: Smoother startup update checks

sections.title: Update checks
items: Wait for the network to become ready before the startup check and silently retry once after a temporary network failure
Always prioritize manual checks so a background retry no longer extends their waiting time
Show a clear timeout message instead of exposing the underlying AbortSignal error

en.notice: Fully restart Tabby after updating. Existing command libraries and plugin settings are preserved.
